title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented milestones and recurring Academy practices that mark the cadet experience from arrival through leadership development.

cards.title: In-processing Day (I-Day)
cards.subtitle: Cadet entry tradition
cards.notes: Watch official Academy announcements for the annual in-processing schedule and public-attendance guidance before planning any visit to this military installation.
cards.short_summary: The Academy identifies I-Day as the first milestone in a cadet’s journey.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists In-processing as the first of its Academy milestones.
cards.access_notes: Base access and event access rules apply; check the Academy’s current visitor guidance.

cards.title: Basic Cadet Training
cards.subtitle: Cadet entry tradition
cards.notes: Use Academy-published information to understand this foundational six-week training phase; it is a formal cadet program, not a visitor activity.
cards.short_summary: Basic Cadet Training is an Academy-defined milestone before cadets join the Cadet Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy’s milestones page includes Basic Cadet Training, and its Acceptance Day page describes it as six weeks of mental, physical and military training.
cards.access_notes: This is an official cadet training program; it is not open for casual participation.

cards.title: Acceptance Day Parade
cards.subtitle: Stillman Parade Field milestone
cards.notes: If attending as a guest, confirm the current parade date and installation-entry requirements through Academy channels before traveling to Stillman Parade Field.
cards.short_summary: The parade formally welcomes basic cadets into the Cadet Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: Acceptance Day celebrates completion of Basic Cadet Training; freshmen receive fourth-class shoulder boards and are accepted into the Cadet Wing.
cards.access_notes: The Academy states guests may observe the parade from Stillman Parade Field stands, subject to current base-access guidance.

cards.title: Squadron Shuffle
cards.subtitle: Cadet Wing milestone
cards.notes: Treat this as a cadet-life milestone rather than a public program; use Academy updates for context if it appears on a current event or parent schedule.
cards.short_summary: The Academy names Squadron Shuffle among the milestones that structure cadet life.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy includes Squadron Shuffle in its official milestones sequence.
cards.access_notes: Cadet schedules and installation access are controlled by the Academy.

cards.title: Parents’ Weekend
cards.subtitle: Family connection milestone
cards.notes: Check the Academy’s current parent information before making plans, since program details, access procedures, and guest instructions can change each year.
cards.short_summary: The annual weekend reconnects cadets and families after Basic Cadet Training.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says Parents’ Weekend occurs every year over Labor Day weekend and lets cadets connect with families for the first time after Basic Cadet Training.
cards.access_notes: Consult current Academy parent and visitor guidance for attendance and base-entry details.

cards.title: Exemplar Dinner
cards.subtitle: Cadet development milestone
cards.notes: Look for Academy-published coverage or schedules to learn how this named dinner fits the cadet experience; do not assume public attendance.
cards.short_summary: Exemplar Dinner is one of the named milestones in the Academy’s official cadet journey.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists Exemplar Dinner among its official milestones.
cards.access_notes: This is a cadet-program milestone; attendance is governed by Academy procedures.

cards.title: Majors Night
cards.subtitle: Academic-choice milestone
cards.notes: Use current Academy academic resources to explore majors and treat this named event as a cadet milestone, not a general public open house.
cards.short_summary: Majors Night marks an academic decision point in the official Academy milestone sequence.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists Majors Night among its official milestones.
cards.access_notes: Availability and attendance are determined by current Academy schedules.

cards.title: Commitment Dinner
cards.subtitle: Cadet commitment milestone
cards.notes: Follow official Academy communications for the current context of this milestone and any applicable guest or installation-access procedures.
cards.short_summary: Commitment Dinner is a named step in the Academy’s official milestones.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists Commitment Dinner among its official milestones.
cards.access_notes: This is a cadet-focused event; public access is not asserted.

cards.title: National Character and Leadership Symposium
cards.subtitle: NCLS milestone
cards.notes: Check official NCLS communications for the current program and registration details; this recurring symposium is part of the Academy’s milestone framework.
cards.short_summary: NCLS is the Academy’s named character-and-leadership symposium milestone.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Air Force Academy lists NCLS among its official milestones.
cards.access_notes: Participation and any guest access depend on the current Academy program.

cards.title: Wing Open Boxing
cards.subtitle: Cadet Wing competition
cards.notes: Experience this through official coverage or authorized event information; the tournament is organized as a supervised Academy boxing competition for cadets.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Cadet Wing boxing tournament culminates in championship bouts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says Wing Open Boxing has run since 1958, with eligible cadets from all 40 squadrons trying out through inter-squadron competition.
cards.access_notes: Cadet participation is through Academy-supervised programming; verify any spectator access with current Academy information.
